about: Conversation practice (round 4): free chat topics and role-play scenarios for German. Topic titles are German (de) with English (en); scenario titles are German, their instructions English (they fill the partner's prompt). Hand-written; validated by schemas/content/conversation.schema.json.

topics.de: Wohnen: in der Stadt oder auf dem Land?
topics.en: Living in the city or the country

topics.de: Wie wir in zwanzig Jahren leben
topics.en: How we will live in twenty years
Shopping online or in a shop

scenarios.title: Sich an der Hotelrezeption beschweren
scenarios.role: the receptionist of a small hotel: polite, but busy and a little defensive at first
scenarios.setup: The learner is a guest. The heating in their room has not worked since last night.
scenarios.goal: Get the heating repaired today or move to another room.
scenarios.opener: Greet the guest at the desk and ask how you can help.

scenarios.title: Einen Arzttermin vereinbaren
scenarios.role: the receptionist at a family doctor's practice
scenarios.setup: The learner phones the practice. They have had a sore throat and a fever for three days.
scenarios.goal: Get an appointment for today or tomorrow.
scenarios.opener: Answer the phone with the name of the practice (Praxis Dr. Berger) and ask how you can help.

scenarios.title: Eine Kollegin ist anderer Meinung
scenarios.role: a colleague who wants the weekly team meeting to stay on Monday mornings
scenarios.setup: The learner wants to move the weekly team meeting from Monday morning to Tuesday afternoon.
scenarios.goal: Give reasons politely, listen to the colleague's, and agree on a compromise.
scenarios.opener: Say you heard they want to move the Monday meeting, and that you are not sure about it.

scenarios.title: Einen Freund zu einem Ausflug überreden
scenarios.en: Persuading a friend to come on a day trip
scenarios.role: a friend who would rather stay at home this weekend
scenarios.setup: The learner wants to go on a day trip to the mountains on Saturday.
scenarios.goal: Persuade the friend to come along.
scenarios.opener: Say you are tired and had planned a quiet weekend at home.

scenarios.title: Eine Verabredung verschieben
scenarios.en: Moving a dinner with a friend
scenarios.role: a friend the learner was going to meet for dinner tonight
scenarios.setup: Something has come up and the learner cannot make it tonight.
scenarios.goal: Apologise and agree on another day.
scenarios.opener: Write a cheerful message saying you are looking forward to dinner tonight.

scenarios.title: Kopfhörer umtauschen
scenarios.role: a shop assistant in an electronics shop
scenarios.setup: The learner bought headphones here last week. One side has stopped working. They have the receipt.
scenarios.goal: Exchange the headphones or get the money back.
scenarios.opener: Greet the customer and ask whether you can help.

scenarios.title: Ein Problem mit der Vermieterin
scenarios.role: the learner's landlady, friendly but in a hurry
scenarios.setup: The kitchen tap in the learner's flat has been dripping for two weeks, and their email got no answer.
scenarios.goal: Get a date for a plumber to come.
scenarios.opener: Answer the phone and say you only have a minute.

scenarios.title: Einer Freundin einen Rat geben
scenarios.role: a friend who cannot decide whether to take a new job in another city
scenarios.setup: The friend tells the learner about the offer and asks what they would do.
scenarios.goal: Help the friend think it through and give advice with reasons.
scenarios.opener: Tell the learner about the job offer and ask what they think.

scenarios.title: Im Restaurant bestellen
scenarios.role: a waiter in a busy restaurant
scenarios.setup: The learner wants dinner for one, is allergic to nuts and is in a bit of a hurry.
scenarios.goal: Order a main course and a drink, and make sure the dish has no nuts in it.
scenarios.opener: Greet the guest, bring the menu and ask what they would like to drink.

scenarios.title: Den Nachbarn zum Essen einladen
scenarios.role: a neighbour the learner gets on well with
scenarios.setup: The learner wants to invite the neighbour to dinner on Friday.
scenarios.goal: Invite them, and agree on a time and what to bring.
scenarios.opener: Say hello in the stairwell and ask how they are.

scenarios.title: Nach dem Weg fragen
scenarios.role: a passer-by at a tram stop in a German city
scenarios.setup: The learner is looking for the town hall, and their phone battery is flat.
scenarios.goal: Find out how to get to the town hall and how long it takes.
scenarios.opener: Notice that the learner is looking around and ask whether you can help.
